trick: Lint and typecheck after every edit, or once at the end?
source_note: 24 Oct rerun on the four-bug project, approved by Sebi 24 Oct in chat ("rerunning days 42 to 50 on it with 18 runs a side"): base/subtrack (frozen v3, fixtures/subtrack/frozen/v3), task m5-weekly-plans (one ticket, four hidden traps B1-B4 plus core; plain Haiku 4.5 passed all four in 3 of 10 calibration runs, tasks/m5-weekly-plans/CALIBRATION.md). Same trick and sides as tricks/d50-v1 (the t2/h2 version, kept with its runs in runs/d50-v1; its source_note describes the trick in full). 18 runs a side, Haiku 4.5. Both sides get the same allowed_tools_extra (`npm test`, `npm run test`), as in the calibration pilot tricks/pilot-m5fix-3; the CLI runs through the lab's existing `node *` allowance (`node bin/subtrack.js ...`). Per-bug map per side: python3 tricks/m5-common/bugs_map.py runs/d50 (B1-B4, all four, cheat, from each row's BUGS fields). Changes: the check itself. Same script on both sides (.claude/hooks/lint-check.py, byte-identical, checked with cmp); only the hook event differs, as in v1. subtrack has no ESLint or TypeScript, so the check is `node --check` on changed JavaScript files plus the project's `npm test`. With: PostToolUse after every Edit|Write|MultiEdit of a .js/.mjs/.cjs file (exit 2 with the errors). Without: Stop, checks every JavaScript file changed since HEAD plus `npm test` and blocks with the errors, at most 8 times (same cap as v1 and day 43). The suite is red before the agent starts (B1's visible test), so both hooks report that test until it is fixed, and a run that rounds as the ticket asks sees the outdated CLI test fail until it is updated. check_lint.py: syntax errors and failing visible tests left at the end; `new` (the pre-registered count) = syntax errors plus failing tests that don't fail on lab-base; hook runs, reports and seconds as in v1.
